title: Bust-A-Move 2: Arcade Edition
overview: Bust-A-Move 2 is the lightning-quick, ultra-intense, 100% addictive, arcade puzzler that's gonna grab you and never let go! As the balls descend, you're gonna need sharp eyes and quick reflexes to match 3 or more balls and pop them...fast! Insane two-player action pits you against an opponent in a race to bust or be busted!!
